class.name: GameplayAttributeWatch
class.brief_description: A subscription to changes in one attribute on one owner.
class.description: Create a watch with [method GameplayAttributes.watch_attribute] and keep a reference to it while listening. Read [method get_value] to initialize a display, then listen for [signal changed] to update it as confirmed values arrive.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the latest detached reading for the watched ID, or [code]null[/code] when the ID is unavailable. Use this method when first attaching a display or when binding it to a different owner.

signal.name: changed
signal.description: Emitted after a committed change or a change in availability for the watched ID. A newly available reading has a [code]null[/code] [param previous] value. An unavailable reading has a [code]null[/code] [param current] value. Both readings are detached.
